title: Esses workbook (workbook-1)
description: A workbook: workbooks/<name>.workbook.json in a project and data/workbooks/circuit-default.workbook.json shipped (02 section 6.4, 04 section 7.3, 06 section 4, D-019). Ordered worksheets whose components sit on free fractional rectangles. The id keys the per-user dock perspective (D-019, D-071); a file without one gets uuidFromHash(hash128({"workbook", file name})) on load. Worksheet names are unique within the workbook and component ids within a worksheet (checked by the loader). Unknown top-level members are allowed and preserved verbatim (02 section 6.1); worksheets and component headers are closed.

$schema.description: Schema id (D-072). The urn:esses: form is written; the bare esses: form of earlier drafts and the later https form are accepted on load and normalised on save (02 section 6.6 rule 1).

schemaVersion.description: Minor version within major 1 (02 section 6.6 rule 1).

id.description: Workbook UUID, set when the workbook is created.

activeWorksheet.description: Worksheet shown on the first open when .local/layout.json has no entry (06 section 4.1 item 5).

x-i2.description: Imported workbook attributes that are not implemented (D-019).

fraction.description: A fraction of the worksheet, 0 at the left or top edge, 1 at the right or bottom.

component.description: One component (04 section 7.3 header). Esses writes every header member; body and x-i2 when present. A type that is not one of the ten MVP types, or a newer version of one, is preserved verbatim and drawn as a placeholder (D-019); its body is never re-serialised from a typed struct. The body is validated by the component's own schema (schemas/components/<type>-<version>.schema.json), not here.

id.description: Component UUID; derived from the worksheet id and the index when absent (the workbook is then dirty).

type.description: Component type: time_distance, outing, scatter, histogram, channel_report, time_report, track_position, values_list, gauge_numeric, gauge_bar, or a later type.

rect.description: [l, t, r, b] fractions of the worksheet, l < r and t < b (checked by the loader); components may overlap.

z.description: Paint order, ascending; equal z paints in array order.

links.description: Which shared view state the component follows (D-018).

activeChannel.description: Channel name of the active-channel square; empty for none.

body.description: Type-specific persistence record (04 sections 8.14-17); channel references are names.

x-i2.description: Imported attributes that are not implemented, kept for a round trip (D-019).

worksheet.description: One worksheet (06 section 4): its components on free fractional rectangles.

id.description: Worksheet UUID; derived from the workbook id and the index when absent.

linkTo.description: Title of the profile data view the worksheet follows ("Laps", "Outings").

domain.description: Initial x domain of the worksheet (F9 toggles it per worksheet).

legacyBag.description: Fields removed by a migration, kept verbatim (02 section 6.6 rule 3).
